note: Agents add findings here in proposed state. Every finding needs an annotated mobile-viewport screenshot (about 393x852) from the Vercel preview and a link to official documentation with the supporting line quoted. Without both, it shows Incomplete and is not eligible for approval. The owner has findings reviewed externally, then moves them to approved or rejected. Basis marks what was checked directly (verified) versus reported (belief).

findings.title: Full-screen back swipe pops screens mid-scroll

evidence.text: fullScreenGestureEnabled: true for court, run, player, notifications, match, challenge, settings and localplus screens.
The full-width pan cancels scroll touches.

Quality, docs and Vercel build green. The Vercel preview loads but stops at sign-in, so the drawer proof is the earlier before/after test on a build of the same code. The Expo Go preview publish was still running at 17:37 UTC.

findings.cause: fullScreenGestureEnabled runs a full-width pan on every detail screen, so a sideways swipe anywhere pops the screen and cancels scrolling. The iOS standard is the left-edge swipe.

fix.summary: Turn the full-screen gesture off; the left-edge swipe and the back icon still work. PR #72 holds the same change and was never merged.

findings.risk: Low. Back by edge swipe and by the back icon are unchanged.
findings.verify: On a phone in the PR preview build: swipe from the left edge goes back; a sideways swipe in the middle of a scrolling screen does not. Belief until then; the web build cannot test it. Use the PR's Expo Go preview.

findings.title: Form drawers drag from anywhere inside, then snap back

evidence.text: gorhom content panning left on for every drawer.
Form drawers (I'll be there, Pick a court, Log game) hold a plain ScrollView or KeyboardAwareScrollView.

evidence.ref: Web gesture test, Log game drawer, 393x852, mouse drag 200px inside the form
evidence.text: main: drawer title y 92 to 275 (moved 183px), then back to 92. Branch: stays at 92. Grabber drag still moves it.
Drawer stays put with the fix. A mouse stands in for touch, so this is not a phone test.

Quality, docs and Vercel build green. The Vercel preview loads but stops at sign-in, so the drawer proof is the earlier before/after test on a build of the same code. The Expo Go preview publish was still running at 17:37 UTC.

findings.cause: Content panning is enabled on every drawer, so touching anywhere in a form drags it down, then it snaps back up.

fix.summary: New contentPanning prop on AppBottomSheetModal; form drawers pass false so only the grabber row drags. Scrolling and dynamic drawers are unchanged.

findings.risk: Low. Form drawers dismiss by grabber drag, tap-out or swipe down from the grabber only.
findings.verify: On a phone: open Log game and try to drag from inside the form (should not move); drag the grabber (should move). Belief until then. Use the PR's Expo Go preview.
